name: story-sfx-dense
label: Story edit, SFX-dense (editbymmh / Metro Media House)
description: Founder/celebrity story reels: VO-led, archival + editorial white cards, cut every ~0.5 s, word-by-word small captions, and a sound layer on almost everything. Continuous bed, 40-60 % of cuts carry a whoosh/thump, ticks on type-ons, swell -> impact + sub-boom stacks on reveals with a 150-400 ms bed hole, rare silence beats. Measured on ed04-ed09 (research/refs-2026-10-25/editbymmh-sound.md).

_needs_feature.sfx.map.cut / cut_burst / section / numb: auto_sfx event sources beyond hook/broll/zoom; map.title and map.end exist in _defaults but are never read today
_needs_feature.sfx.map values naming a stack + sfx.stac: one cue -> several layered sounds, each with own db, probability p and role placement
_needs_feature.sfx kinds swell, tick, glitch, boom, pap: new KINDS entries in sfx.py with Openverse queries, durations, align/offset; synth fallbacks in render.SFX_SYNTH
_needs_feature.sfx.cut_coverage: share of item boundaries that get a cut cue (deterministic hash pick)
_needs_feature.sfx.title_word_every: tick on every Nth caption word appear (word-by-word kinetic text)
_needs_feature.sfx.min_gap_s / reserve_for_reveal / max: budget spread over time instead of list truncation
_needs_feature.sfx.gain_jitter_db: per-cue random gain, deterministic by cue time
_needs_feature.sfx.offset_ms: per-preset override of KINDS offset_ms; whoosh_peak/swell_peak are peak-aligned
_needs_feature.sfx.stacks.*.pre_lap_ms: start a layer's body before the cut (ed08 low-end pre-lap)
_needs_feature.sfx.tails: 'ring' = never truncate SFX at the next cut (already true in render; keep when pre-mixing)
_needs_feature.sfx.silence: mute bed + SFX (not voice) for len_s at named moments
_needs_feature.sfx.qc_targets: qc.py audio check against these ranges
_needs_feature.music.duck_depth_db / insert_duck_db: replace fixed sidechain ratio 6 with a target depth; deeper duck under inserted clip audio
_needs_feature.music.bed_always / bed_fallback: always lay a bed; synth/library 'texture' when no music given
_needs_feature.music.drop_before_reveal_s / drop_floor_: bed hole automation before reveal stacks
_needs_feature.music.new_cue_after_reveal: switch to the next music section/cue at a reveal
_needs_feature.transitions.default 'cut' + burst_flash_: flash-frame stutter bursts at section changes (only 'flicker' exists today)
_needs_feature.render: SFX stem pre-mix: 60-100 cues per reel; mix SFX to one stem before the ffmpeg graph
